tagline: STIHL equipment and expertise for Dargaville locals
heroSubheading: Sales, servicing and parts for outdoor power equipment
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Dargaville, stocking outdoor power equipment for locals and their land. Whether you're after a new chainsaw, trimmer, or blower, we have the gear and we know it well. Stewart Mills runs the shop, and we're here to help you find what works for your place.

We service and repair STIHL equipment, and stock genuine parts for everything we sell. Locals come to us because we give straight advice and we get the work done right. If you need new gear, repairs, or help deciding what's best, come in and we'll sort you out.

We're open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5pm, Saturday 8:30am to 3pm, and Sunday 9am to 3pm.
servicesIntro: We service STIHL equipment and stock genuine parts for all models
